name: Daigo (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Daigo town emblem in navy: a stylised device of two mirrored angular strokes, like a bow tie.
history: Municipal flag of Daigo, a town in Ibaraki Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The flag was adopted on 26 August 2013; the emblem dates from 12 September 1961.

features.role: Daigo town emblem — a stylised device of two mirrored angular strokes, like a bow tie
